stories.title: Maharaja Whiteline marks 50 years with campaign
stories.summary: Maharaja Whiteline is launching a campaign titled Jiyo Life Maharaja Style to celebrate its 50th anniversary. The brand says it aims to reinforce values of trust and legacy by focusing on everyday home life. The company has been selling home appliances in India since 1976.

stories.title: ALDI Australia features tinsel family in Christmas ad
stories.summary: ALDI Australia has released a festive campaign featuring the Tinsleys, a family made of tinsel who have lost their sparkle. The brand suggests an affordable Christmas range can help them shine again. The marketing director says customers should not feel they need to compromise this holiday season.

stories.title: Hershey’s Kisses targets Diwali couples
stories.summary: Hershey’s India has launched a Diwali campaign for its Kisses brand, focusing on the difficulty of finding private moments during family gatherings. The digital film depicts a couple interrupted by relatives until a chocolate offer provides a romantic distraction. The campaign platform is titled Giving Kisses Is Hard.

stories.title: Swiss Beauty taps Taapsee Pannu for festive campaign
stories.summary: Cosmetics brand Swiss Beauty has launched a festive campaign titled We Got You, featuring actor Taapsee Pannu. The brand says it aims to highlight makeup performance during high-energy celebrations. The film features Pannu dancing to a 1990s track to demonstrate that products can remain reliable during festivities.

stories.title: KitKat campaign addresses festive mishaps
stories.summary: VML India has created a festive campaign for KitKat that frames minor holiday mishaps as part of the experience. Nestlé India says the brand serves as a companion for meaningful breaks during the chaos of celebrations. The company suggests that taking a pause can lighten the festive mood.

stories.title: McDonald’s US marketing chief departs
stories.summary: Alyssa Buetikofer, the chief marketing and customer experience officer for McDonald’s USA, will leave the company next month. The executive, who held the role for less than two years, is departing to spend time with her family. Two interim executives will support the brand during the search.

stories.title: Agencies shift focus to influencer marketing
stories.summary: Creative and media agencies are increasingly adding influencer marketing to their service offerings as creator budgets grow. Managing director Michelle Hampton notes that agencies follow the money, though she argues that creator marketing requires more than just a bolt-on approach to be effective. Everyone is doing it.

stories.title: Barcode Entertainment discusses influencer industry shifts
stories.summary: Ajay Kulkarni of Barcode Entertainment says the influencer industry is undergoing a structural shift as brands build internal capabilities and technology automates campaign functions. He suggests that agencies must move beyond routine management to retain relevance as advertisers seek more control over their own creator partnerships.

stories.title: TBWA\Lintas wins Starbucks India creative mandate
stories.summary: TBWA\Lintas has been awarded the integrated creative mandate for Starbucks India following a multi-agency pitch. The agency will manage digital communication and consumer participation as the brand expands into smaller cities. The cafe market in India is projected to reach USD 1.1 billion by 2034.

stories.title: Extreme Reach expands payroll platform to creators
stories.summary: Extreme Reach has launched a payroll platform for creators, aiming to consolidate onboarding and tax documentation. The company says it believes creators are the next celebrities in advertising. The move follows an industry shift toward using influencers as a core component of modern marketing strategies.

stories.title: Meta alleges policy circumvention in court case
stories.summary: Meta Platforms has opposed a plea by Blink Digital to restore its advertising infrastructure. Meta alleges the agency promoted ban-proof accounts and facilitated loan scams and sexual clickbait. The Bombay High Court has reserved its order on the agency's request for relief. The platform is not amused.

stories.title: Instagram pushes long-form video without a payment plan
stories.summary: Instagram now allows videos up to 90 minutes long to compete with YouTube. While the platform is paying select creators between $50,000 and $500,000 to post, it has no general monetization model. The company says it is too early to share how creators will actually get paid.

stories.title: Whalar Group on the evolution of creator partnerships
stories.summary: Whalar Group co-CEO Neil Waller says creators now sit at the heart of brand strategy, often owning stakes in the companies they represent. The next phase of the creator economy relies on operational rigor and mutual respect. AI is also expected to change how these partnerships function.

stories.title: Political creators diversify platforms by function
stories.summary: Political creators are increasingly assigning specific jobs to different platforms rather than choosing one. YouTube serves as the business engine, while Instagram provides reach. TikTok offers distribution, and Substack or Patreon handle owned businesses. The modern creator stack is built on utility rather than platform loyalty.

stories.title: Meta removes ad placement controls for advertisers
stories.summary: Meta is removing the ability for advertisers to exclude specific placements from their ad sets. Advertisers will no longer be able to selectively prevent ads from appearing in Facebook search results or between Reels. The company is effectively taking away the option to choose where ads run.

stories.summary: Meta Weighs AI Chat Ads, Potentially Reshuffling Search and Social Budgets Generative AI is pushing the digital advertising battlefield away from social feeds and search results pages and toward question-and-answer conversational interfaces. The market is watching whether Meta will introduce ChatGPT-style sponsored placements into its

stories.summary: The next battleground for digital advertising could move beyond social feeds and search results into AI-powered conversations, with Meta's potential entry into conversational advertising threatening to redirect marketing budgets from its own platforms and Google Search. While Meta has not publicly confirmed plans to introduce

stories.title: Meta delays commercial terms update after industry backlash
stories.summary: Meta has indefinitely delayed new commercial terms following complaints from publishers and advertisers. Critics argued the changes gave the company overly broad rights to use their content for AI services. Meta rejected the claims but paused the rollout after hearing feedback from its partners.

stories.title: AI complicates marketing centralization
stories.summary: Marketing technology platforms are increasingly struggling with the complexities of AI integration. As companies attempt to centralize their operations, the addition of automated tools has introduced new layers of friction. The full piece is available for subscribers who wish to read about the ongoing technical challenges.

stories.title: Turning AI productivity into marketing ROI
stories.summary: Companies are looking for ways to translate the time saved by AI tools into measurable financial returns. The shift from simple productivity gains to actual marketing revenue remains a primary focus for industry leaders. The full piece is available for subscribers who want to see the math.

stories.title: QuestionPro acquires Contlo to enter agentic commerce
stories.summary: QuestionPro has acquired AI-native platform Contlo to expand into agentic commerce. The deal integrates SuperAGI technology across the company's product suite to turn customer insights into personalized action. Contlo co-founders will join as AI advisors. The goal is simple, though the agents are still learning to execute it.

stories.title: Theorem launches founding partner program for Shopify brands
stories.summary: Theorem has launched a 90-day program for Shopify retailers to access its Upward for D2C solution. Selected brands receive free access to identify storefront conversion gaps and activate video content. The program aims to improve shopping experiences. It is a free offer for those who qualify.

stories.title: Using AI agents to improve customer experience
stories.summary: AI agents are being deployed to manage customer interactions with the goal of improving overall service quality. Companies are evaluating how these automated systems handle inquiries compared to traditional methods. The full piece is available for subscribers interested in the current state of automated customer support.

stories.title: Cyara launches CX trust platform for AI agents
stories.summary: Cyara has launched its Agentic CX Trust Platform to provide independent oversight of AI agent conversations. The system scores interactions for quality and compliance while turning production failures into mandatory tests. Enterprises can now show how their agents behave. Failures are now officially part of the process.

stories.title: Evaluating martech platforms with AI context
stories.summary: Purchasing a marketing technology platform now requires a deeper understanding of how AI is integrated into the software. Buyers are advised to conduct thorough assessments before committing to new tools. The full piece is available for subscribers who are currently in the market for new software.

stories.title: Salesforce to acquire AI customer support firm Cresta
stories.summary: Salesforce is moving to acquire Cresta, a company specializing in AI-driven customer support tools. The acquisition follows a broader industry trend of integrating automated intelligence into enterprise service platforms. The full piece is available for subscribers who want to track the latest corporate consolidation in the sector.

stories.title: AI traffic reportedly drives higher revenue
stories.summary: New data suggests that traffic generated by AI tools results in 83 percent more revenue per visit compared to traditional sources. The findings highlight a significant shift in how automated engagement impacts e-commerce performance. The full piece is available for subscribers who want to see the data.

research.title: Beyond the Keyword: A Human-Annotated Benchmark for Arabic Anxiety-Related Discourse
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Keyword retrieval returns expressions of personal anxiety together with many other uses of anxiety-related language. We present a benchmark of 1,000 Arabic Twitter/X posts retrieved with the keyword qalaq ("anxiety/worry") and annotated for six discourse functions. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: CasHyper: Modeling Multi-Factor Interactions and Asymmetric Influence in Cascade Prediction via Hypercomplex Algebra
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Cascade prediction aims to forecast the future evolution of information diffusion and is an important task in social network analysis. Most existing methods represent users and cascades in real-valued Euclidean spaces, which may offer limited capacity. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Efficiently Estimating Cycle Statistics on Graphs via Spanning Trees
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Simple cycles encode feedback and alternative routes in networks and are important for routing problems, the convergence of dynamical processes on networks, message passing and belief propagation, or even static network characterizations such as structural balance. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: No Note Is an Island: Probing LLMs' Understanding of Crowdsourced Fact-Checking Environments
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly assist crowdsourced fact-checking, yet evaluations focus on individual annotations. A correction's reach and reception depend on visibility, audience responses, and platform policies. We introduce correction context understanding: assessing corrective content, interpreting. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
